text:
Nora: Quick sync - Datadog asked for a 'marketplace observability QA' checklist we can hand to SIs and HW partners. Can we sketch it here?
Diego: short list ok: 1) OTLP sample, 2) dashboard JSON, 3) network/firewall kibosh notes for VPC, 4) air-gap export flow.
Aria: +1 add a tiny troubleshooting section: common causes for missing traces (API key, TLS issues, high cardinality).
Sam (eng): will add the OTEL snippet and a demo runtime flag. minimal exporter we'll show:
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    endpoint: "https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317"
    headers:
      DD_API_KEY: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```
Sam (eng): runtime flag: REDWOOD_TRACE_ENRICH=true (enables model and model_version tags). recommend sampling prompt_id at 0.5% by default.
Diego: for hardware partners include: bundle export for air-gap, and proxy-forward snippet for customers who proxy outbound traffic. one-liner for runbook.
Aria: dashboard widgets to include: p95 latency by model, token-cost timeseries, error traces filtered by model tag. keep JSON under 200KB for marketplace.
Nora: add a one-liner about cardinality: "Limit high-cardinality enrichments (prompt_id) unless sampling; use model_version for rollouts."
Devops-bot: endpoint-check: OTLP endpoint reachable from staging cluster - OK
Sam (eng): fallback behavior note: buffer-to-disk when DD unreachable: set BUFFER_PATH=/var/lib/redwood/trace-buffer and FLUSH_INTERVAL=30s. will add to runbook.
Diego: timeline: drafts by Thurs EOD, dry-run next Mon. Nora will own packaging the repo and partner-facing README.
Nora: thanks — i'll make the repo and link here when ready. short 10m review call Mon 11am PT. :calendar:
